description: Somos un equipo de Termas de Río Hondo, Santiago del Estero, con ganas de usar tecnología espacial para resolver problemas reales de nuestra región. Trabajaremos con datos del radar NISAR, que ve a través de nubes, humo y vegetación, para seguir cambios como incendios, inundaciones y pérdida del monte, combinándolo con otros datos satelitales, que cualquiera pueda usar, desde productores rurales hasta bomberos.
summary: Termal Wave is an interactive 3D globe that helps people see how the land is changing, even when clouds or smoke hide ordinary satellite photos. Built for the NASA Space Apps 2026 challenge "Dancing with the SARs," it centers on NASA-ISRO NISAR L-band radar and is designed as a global environmental impact detection environment. Its first focus is the dry Chaco forest of Santiago del Estero, Argentina, a region affected by land clearing and wildfires. The prototype presents radar backscatter and change between dates on a MapLibre globe, together with NASA FIRMS active-fire hotspots and NASA GIBS basemaps. A before-and-after swipe and a pixel-art guide explain the radar in plain language. Every layer carries an honesty badge (MEASURED, DERIVED, INFERRED, SIMULATED, or EXAMPLE) so users can tell a measurement from an illustrative example. The app is a working prototype, not an operational system. Intended users include a provincial forest brigade, an agronomist, and a teacher or neighbor who needs evidence they can share.
details: Termal Wave turns NASA-ISRO NISAR radar into a readable picture of surface change. Users fly a 3D globe, open an area of interest (Santiago del Estero first), move along a timeline and compare dates with a swipe. Optional layers add NASA FIRMS hotspots and NASA GIBS basemaps, and a pixel-art wizard explains the radar in plain language. Built with Vite, TypeScript, React and MapLibre GL JS on Cloudflare Workers, with a Python pipeline (NumPy, h5py, Pillow) that queries NASA CMR/Earthdata and ASF for NISAR coverage. This is a prototype: some layers are illustrative and labeled EXAMPLE or SIMULATED, and the demo video uses conceptual mockups based on the real interface.
dataRefs: NISAR L-band SAR (NASA Earthdata, CMR, ASF DAAC/Vertex)
projectRefs: ISRO / ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 via EOxCloudless
